{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Just think of it, complete mobility for the first time since I was activated.|[[M-TD]] exclaiming about micro repulsors to [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]]|<ref name="Young Jedi Knights: Delusions of Grandeur">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Delusions of Grandeur]]''</ref>}}
'''Micro repulsorlifts''' were smaller, compact versions of [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]]. They were often used on small probes and other smaller [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. The [[translator droid/Legends|Translator droid]] [[M-TD]] was fitted with an array of micro repulsorlifts that allowed him to move through the air.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> The [[Droideka/Legends|Droideka series]] used micro repulsorlifts to assist the droid's "wheel mode" propulsion method.<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref>

[[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions']] [[PLX-2M portable missile launcher]] had a built-in microrepulsorlight unit. The unit stabilized and supported the [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launcher]] during use, eliminating the need for a [[Tripod (weapon attachment)/Legends|tripod]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
